programme.title: Best In The Desert Vegas To Reno LIVE Part 1
programme.desc: The Casey Folks "Vegas to Reno" Off-Road Race is widely known as the longest off-road race in the United States, typically stretching roughly 500 miles through the grueling Nevada desert. For its 30th anniversary, the race will run "The Other Way" for the first time in history, meaning competitors will start in Reno and finish near Las Vegas.
